description: Reissue an existing certificate from a new CSR (Certificate Manager 2.0). DCV is by DNS CNAME record (validationMethod D). Use dryRun=true to preview. Public zone only. Requires a main-account API key — Certificate Manager 2.0 rejects Sub Account keys with HTTP 403 (confirmed by Ncloud support; verified 2026-10-02 with NCP_ADMINISTRATOR).

dnsName.description: Domains for the certificate SAN (Subject Alternative Name)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without reissuing

validationMethod.description: DCV method: D = DNS CNAME record

name: ncloud_cm2_reissue_certificate
